thread:
ashwin: Taking handoff for 12:00-20:00. Quick bullets below.

maria: thanks — adding one note: canary 3.1.2 is live in us-west only, us-east still on 3.1.1.

ashwin: noted. traffic routed by header flag, fallback to stable is enabled.

jules: fyi, model-compile queue had a transient failure at 10:12 but retries succeeded; keeping a close eye for next hour.

ashwin: watchlist: compile-worker service (queue depth), nightly-cache-warmup cron job, and dedicated autoscaler thresholds for transformer pools.

kevin: quick PR ping: #4182 (batching config tweak) needs review; #4201 (KMS rotation) merged and deployed.

ashwin: action items: 1) If text-gen latency >200ms for >3m, flip to smaller model variant. 2) If spot hosts drop >=3 in a zone, escalate to infra on-call. 3) Rollback canary if error rate >1% over 5m.

maria: commands to check if anything looks off: `kubectl get pods -n runtime -o wide` and tail logs with `stern compile-worker -n runtime`.

deploy-bot: deploy completed for canary 3.1.2 — duration 2m34s, no errors. :white_check_mark:

ashwin: small log snippet from earlier failure:
```
compile-worker-7f8c9 ERROR compile failed: OOM when allocating KV cache
retrying (attempt 2)
```

jules: I spun up a temporary dashboard panel for compile queue depth — https://grafana.company/redwood/d/compile (short-term link).

kevin: I'll take #4182 in ~30m and ping when it's ready.

ashwin: handing off now — reach me @ashwin for anything urgent, otherwise page infra on-call for spot capacity alerts. :phone:
